Failure Signature (regex): markAsUncloneable is not a function|Node\.js v20|ERR_REQUIRE_ESM.*salesforce
Root Cause: Salesforce CLI (bundled undici) is incompatible with Node 20.
Recommended Fix: Pin actions/setup-node to node-version "22" in the workflow and the setup-sfdx action.

Failure Signature (regex): sObject type '[^']+' is not supported|INVALID_TYPE|INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS|Metadata API.*not enabled
Root Cause: The deploy Run-As user lacks object/metadata permissions (restricted profile).
Recommended Fix: Give the Client-Credentials Run-As user System Administrator, or a permission set with "Modify Metadata Through Metadata API Functions" + "API Enabled".

Root Cause: Org authentication failed (wrong client id/secret, run-as user, or app not propagated).
Recommended Fix: Verify SF_CLIENT_ID/SF_CLIENT_SECRET and SF_INSTANCE_URL (My Domain); confirm Client Credentials Run-As user; wait ~10 min after app changes.

Failure Signature (regex): Code style issues found|Forgot to run Prettier|prettier --check
Recommended Fix: Run "npm run prettier" to auto-format, then commit.

Failure Signature (regex): all of the files matching the glob pattern .* are ignored|No files matching the pattern
Root Cause: ESLint matched no files and errored.
Recommended Fix: Add --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern to the lint script (or add lintable aura/lwc files).
Fix the reported ESLint errors (run "npm run lint" locally to see them).

Failure Signature (regex): No tests found, exiting with code 1
Root Cause: Jest found no tests and failed.
Recommended Fix: Add --passWithNoTests to the jest script, or add LWC unit tests.

Root Cause: One or more Jest unit tests failed.
Recommended Fix: Fix the failing LWC Jest tests (run "npm run test:unit" locally).

Failure Signature (regex): can only install with an existing package-lock\.json|Dependencies lock file is not found|npm ci`? can only
Root Cause: package-lock.json is missing (npm ci / setup-node cache needs it).

Failure Signature (regex): Average test coverage across all Apex|code coverage.*75|test coverage of \d+%
Root Cause: Apex code coverage is below the required 75%.
